## Problem

What user problem or defect does this change address? Link a relevant issue if one exists.

## Change

Describe the resulting behavior and the reason for this approach.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Include a regression case for changed audit behavior.

## Compatibility and risks

Note CLI/JSON changes, unsupported cases, security implications, and migration needs.

## Assistance and provenance

Disclose material AI assistance and any third-party code or attribution requirements.
